body:
Founder real-time, two feature ideas, both explicitly non-urgent ('not sure doesnt need to happen immediately but i think its a good offering'). Planning only, no code shipped, matching the S244 precedent. Wrote 8 real, grounded subtasks into a new EMILY/BACKLOG.md SECTION 245. Mailing-list half (S245-01..05): real, checked finding that IDUNA/internal/mailinglist already has most of the right shape (Store as real system-of-record, MailchimpClient already a clean per-instance struct not baked-in globals) -- the real gaps are a product-appropriate vault-unlock mode (S245-01, honestly naming the trade-off against the current deliberately-paranoid human-passphrase model), a real export endpoint that doesn't exist yet (S245-02), making the Mailchimp config a real per-instance admin setting instead of an env var (S245-03, decisively simplified by IDUNA_PRO's own real one-process-per-tenant multi-tenancy model meaning no shared-state tenant-resolution problem exists), a real settings UI (S245-04), and a corrected re-extraction of the whole package into IDUNA_PRO once S245-01 lands (S245-05, an honest correction to S243-06's own original 'leave behind' categorization, same lesson S243-08's kanban re-categorization already taught: check coupling directly before excluding). Link-tree half (S245-06..08): real, checked precedent found -- IDUNA/internal/blog's own Store+Renderer split is almost exactly the right shape for a linktree page; real, checked gap -- zero analytics/click-tracking exists anywhere in this monorepo today; scoped a real, bounded v0 (tracking-redirect click counts, not a full analytics platform) plus reuse of the already-shipped broker Host-routing (S243-06) to serve each tenant's own public page.

⚓ ☃
title: Mailing-list productization + link-tree mini-site -- real subtask planning pass (SECTION 245)
